title: Page 1
content_zh:
每年，政府机构和民间出版社总会不定期的举办大小财经课程及讲座，邀来国内外各产业的杰出人士及商业菁英担任主讲人，分享他们在投资理财和企业经营上的成功经验。
今年，就读大学三年级的关佳颖也是台下的听众之一，自从她考上大学之后，父亲每年暑假都会替她报名这类商业名人讲座，要她来听听这些知名企业管理人的经营之道，将来好接手家中的餐饮事业。
“谢谢大家……”主讲人在台上向听众致谢，在一片热烈的掌声中结束这场演讲，将麦克风交还给主办单位人员……
“今天这场演讲真精彩，内容充实又不沈闷。”年年奉命陪同老板的女儿前来听演讲，顺便负责讲解的女秘书转头对关佳颖说道。
头一次看小姐听得那么全神贯注，全程都目不转睛的盯着台上看，一个哈欠都没打，就晓得这场演讲有多成功了。
“是啊，他真棒……”关佳颖望着离开讲台的那个男人，口吻充满崇拜。
“妳都写了些什么？”女秘书将小姐的笔记本拿过来，看看她记录了什么重点——
龙腾集团，杜天云。
就这样？！女秘书不敢相信这场前后加起来将近一个半小时的演讲里，这位小姐只写了这么不到一行，还是简介数据上也有印刷的文字。
“小姐，妳对杜总裁的演讲内容没有任何心得吗？”她觉得这是一场让人获益良多的演讲，自己的笔记上都写满两大页密密麻麻的重点呢！
“有。”关佳颖转头看向女秘书，肯定地点头。
“那就好……”她正放心，却看到关佳颖眨着一双水汪汪的大眼睛，说出一个出人意料的答案——
“我觉得我恋爱了。”
第1章(1)
“哥，你确定你真的要这么做？”饭店休息室里，杜天海双手插在西装裤口袋，站在兄长斜后方，透过镜子的反射询问正在镜前打理仪容的杜天云。
距离婚礼只剩二十分钟，身为弟弟的杜天海还是对兄长的婚事心存疑虑，觉得这桩仓促决定的婚事实在太不符合他向来四平八稳的行事作风了。
“是我要结婚，你怎么比我还紧张？”杜天云对着镜中的自己浅笑，按上一枚镶有宝石和碎钻的袖扣，再系上领结，调整角度，每个动作都有条不紊、优雅从容。
穿上银白色的西装外套，他英挺斯文的外表更显得翩然俊雅、文质彬彬，他一贯给人的感觉，总是像个沈稳泰然的绅士。
“我是怕你日理万机，忙坏了脑袋，才会决定娶一个只见过三次面的女人进门。”杜天海懒懒地扣上敞开的衣襟，遮住胸前的项链和结实胸肌，拿出顺手塞在口袋里的领带随意系上。
镜里镜外，宛如白马王子般的杜天云和倜傥不羁的杜天海都是绝对的反比，因此才更难相信兄长会做出这种事。

“为了赶在她出国之前办完这场婚礼，时间是急迫了点，但我不想影响她早就定好的留学计划。”他不疾不徐地说道，毫无异议地配合新婚妻子的学涯规划。
对于他一个月前才与女方相亲认识，而后单独约过两次会就匆促决定要与对方结婚这件事，杜天云身旁的亲友、长辈无一不感到万分错愕，唯独他本人一直表现得泰然自若，好似一切都在他掌控中，没有半点慌忙。
正因为从他身上根本看不出半点被爱情冲昏头而陷入热恋的迹象，才让人更加质疑他结这个婚的正确性。
“哈，这就更可笑了，居然有人结完婚的第二天就要立刻丢下丈夫，一个人飞到欧洲去念书！她是真心想嫁给你的吗？”杜天海讥讽着这桩离谱的婚姻，愈想愈觉得这样的安排难以置信，心想那个女人八成也是脑袋有问题，才会答应这门婚事！
“这问题你得去问她才行。”杜天云衔着一抹轻松的笑容，在光线下专心擦亮他的镜片。
老实说，他一点都不在乎她的答案，因为那并不是左右他结婚的因素。
“怎么样？”他戴上细框眼镜，拉拉挺直的领口，转身问杜天海对自己这身装扮的看法。
不同的场合有不同的打扮，既然他今天是扮演新郎倌的角色，理应就要比在场的其它男士打扮得更慎重、得体才行，这也是对新娘子的尊重。
“很帅，连我都想嫁给你了，白马王子。”杜天海皮笑肉不笑地拍了两下手，有些看不惯他那副悠然自适的态度，简直惬意到像盛装打扮来参加别人的婚礼一样，反而是他这个当弟弟的在旁边替他穷紧张。
“抱歉，老弟，我对搞同性恋没兴趣，更何况娶你一点好处都没有。”他不受影响地说笑，也不介意老弟掷来一记凶狠的瞪视，依旧笑得气定神闲。
杜天海机警地嗅出一丝玄机，感觉大哥话中有话。
“说清楚点，什么好处？”他不耐烦地挑眉，要杜天云从实招来。
杜天云也不隐瞒，坦白告诉他——
“只要我一结婚，‘龙腾’进军食品业的计划就能提早落实。将来我们不仅能获得‘联鑫’的技术支持，还能额外得到它百分之十的股份。”
所以为了抢进商机，取得对“龙腾”最有利的资源，身为集团总裁的杜天云决定接受未来岳父的条件，开口向他女儿求婚，迎娶“联鑫餐饮”的千金为妻，并且赶在她出国前办完这场婚事。
杜天云相信透过“联鑫”几十年来建立的信誉、人脉、技术，对“龙腾”未来的食品事业发展绝对会产生加乘效果，如虎添翼。
“所以你是为了公司的利益才把自己的婚姻当成筹码，答应娶他女儿？”这下杜天海总算搞清楚了，原来大哥不是没有慎重考虑过这桩婚事的可行性，只是他心里盘算的因素是公司，而不是人。
杜天海扯唇一笑，觉得这就有像大哥的作风了。
他这位大哥自从接下总裁这个位置后，就把事业看得比自己的人生还重要，凡事都以集团利益为优先考量，现在会为了公司“献身”也不令人意外。
“任何投资都需要付出成本，况且爸妈也常叫我别只顾着立业，忘了成家。现在我不但要结婚，还在它上头增加了不少附加价值，这样不是很好吗？”他打趣地说，不否认自己确实是以“利”为考量才答应这桩婚事，不过这绝对不是一门亏本的生意，更何况关家的千金无论家世或外表都无可挑剔，和他门当户对。

唯一要说美中不足的地方，大概就是她的年纪实在是小了点，足足差了他八岁半，那脸稚气未褪的五官怎么看都像个小女生……
“但你并不爱她——”杜天海话说到一半，突然收了口，不耐烦地扯开打好的领带。“也对，爱有个屁用，像你这样结婚倒务实点。”他淡淡一哂，将领带塞口袋里，再松开几颗钮扣，还是比较习惯不受拘束的感觉。
杜天云望着弟弟，似乎从他不以为意的笑容里察觉一丝极淡的哀伤，像是一缕轻烟飘在他眉宇间，很快地消逝……
杜天云敛起笑容，知道弟弟此时想到了什么——
“还忘不了她？”他以为事情过了那么多年，伤痛终究会随着时间被冲淡。
“呵，怎么能忘，她可是让我爱到刻骨铭心的女人呢。”杜天海下意识地握住胸前的项链，笑容里的痛又明显了点，但同样很快地被隐没。
content_en:
Every year, government agencies and private publishing houses hold financial courses and lectures from time to time, inviting outstanding figures and business elites from various industries at home and abroad to serve as keynote speakers to share their successful experiences in investment, financial management and business operations.
This year, Guan Jiaying, who is in her third year of college, is also one of the audience. Ever since she was admitted to college, her father has signed up for such business celebrity lectures for her every summer, asking her to come and listen to the management methods of these well-known business managers so that she can take over the family's catering business in the future.
"Thank you all..." The speaker thanked the audience on the stage, ended the speech with warm applause, and handed the microphone back to the organizer...
"Today's speech was really wonderful. It was informative and not boring." Every year, the female secretary who is responsible for explaining the speech turned to Guan Jiaying and said to Guan Jiaying.
It was the first time that the young lady was so absorbed in listening, staring at the stage the whole time without even yawning, so I knew how successful the speech was.
"Yeah, he's awesome..." Guan Jiaying looked at the man leaving the podium, her tone full of admiration.
"What have you written?" The female secretary took the lady's notebook over to see what key points she had recorded——
Longteng Group, Du Tianyun.
that's all? ! The female secretary couldn't believe that in this speech, which lasted for nearly an hour and a half, the lady only wrote less than one line, and there was still printed text on the introduction data.
"Miss, don't you have any experience with the content of President Du's speech?" She felt that this was a speech that benefited a lot of people, and her notes were filled with two pages of densely packed key points!
"Yes." Guan Jiaying turned to look at the female secretary and nodded affirmatively.
"That's good..." She was relieved when she saw Guan Jiaying blinking her big watery eyes and giving an unexpected answer——
"I think I'm in love."
Chapter 1(1)
"Brother, are you sure you really want to do this?" In the hotel lounge, Du Tianhai put his hands in the pockets of his suit pants, standing diagonally behind his brother, and asked Du Tianyun, who was taking care of his appearance in front of the mirror, through the reflection of the mirror.
There were only twenty minutes left before the wedding. As the younger brother, Du Tianhai still had doubts about his brother's marriage. He felt that this hastily decided marriage was too inconsistent with his usual steady style.
"I'm getting married, why are you more nervous than me?" Du Tianyun smiled at himself in the mirror, pressed on a cufflink set with gems and diamonds, tied on his tie, and adjusted the angle. Every movement was methodical, elegant and calm.
Putting on a silver-white suit jacket, his handsome and elegant appearance made him look even more handsome and elegant. He always gave people the impression of being a calm and composed gentleman.
"I'm afraid that you have so many things to do and your brain is so busy that you decide to marry a woman you have only met three times." Du Tianhai lazily buttoned up the open placket, covering the necklace and strong chest muscles on his chest, took out the tie that was conveniently stuffed in his pocket and tied it casually.
In and out of the mirror, Du Tianyun, who is like Prince Charming, and Du Tianhai, who is suave and unruly, are absolutely inverse contrast, so it is even harder to believe that his brother would do such a thing.
"In order to complete this wedding before she goes abroad, time is a little tight, but I don't want to affect her long-decided plan to study abroad." He said unhurriedly, cooperating with his newlywed wife's academic career plan without any objection.
Regarding the fact that he only met the woman on a blind date a month ago, and then decided to marry her in a hurry after two separate appointments, Du Tianyun's relatives, friends, and elders were all extremely shocked. Only he himself had always behaved calmly, as if everything was under his control, without any panic.
It is precisely because there is no sign of being dazzled by love and falling in love from him that it makes people even more suspicious.Questioning the validity of his marriage.
"Ha, this is even more ridiculous. Some people actually abandon their husbands the day after they get married and fly to Europe to study alone! Does she really want to marry you?" Du Tianhai ridiculed this outrageous marriage. The more he thought about it, the more unbelievable this arrangement became. He thought that the woman probably had a brain problem that made her agree to the marriage!
"You have to ask her this question." Du Tianyun said with a relaxed smile and concentrated on polishing his lenses under the light.
To be honest, he didn't care about her answer at all, because that was not the factor that influenced his marriage.
"How's it going?" He put on his thin-framed glasses, straightened his collar, and turned to ask Du Tianhai what he thought of his outfit.
Different occasions require different attire. Since he is playing the role of the groom today, he should dress more carefully and appropriately than other men present. This is also a sign of respect for the bride.
"You're so handsome, even I want to marry you, Prince Charming." Du Tianhai clapped his hands twice with a smile. He couldn't stand his leisurely and comfortable attitude. He was as comfortable as dressing up to attend someone else's wedding. Instead, he, his younger brother, was worried for him.
"Sorry, brother, I'm not interested in being gay, not to mention there is no benefit at all from marrying you." He laughed unaffected, and didn't mind the fierce glare from his brother, still smiling calmly.
Du Tianhai alertly sniffed out a hint of mystery and felt that there was something in his elder brother's words.
"Tell me clearly, what's the benefit?" He raised his eyebrows impatiently, asking Du Tianyun to recruit him honestly.
Du Tianyun didn't hide anything and told him frankly——
"As soon as I get married, Longteng's plan to enter the food industry can be implemented early. In the future, we will not only get technical support from Lianxin, but also get an additional 10% of its shares."
Therefore, in order to seize business opportunities and obtain the most beneficial resources for "Longteng", Du Tianyun, the group president, decided to accept the conditions of his future father-in-law, propose to his daughter, marry the daughter of "Lianxin Catering", and complete the marriage before she goes abroad.
Du Tianyun believes that through the credibility, connections and technology established by "Lianxin" over decades, it will definitely have a multiplier effect on the future development of the food business of "Longteng", making it even more powerful.
"So you used your marriage as a bargaining chip and agreed to marry his daughter for the benefit of the company?" Du Tianhai finally figured it out. It turned out that the eldest brother had not carefully considered the feasibility of this marriage, but the factor in his mind was the company, not the person.
Du Tianhai pulled his lips and smiled, feeling that this was like his elder brother's style.
Since he took over the position of president, his eldest brother has regarded his career as more important than his own life. He prioritizes the interests of the group in everything. It is not surprising that he will "dedicate his life" to the company now.
"Any investment requires a cost, and my parents often tell me not to just focus on building a career and forget about starting a family. Now I not only want to get married, but also add a lot of added value to it, isn't that great?" He said jokingly, not denying that he did consider "profit" before agreeing to the marriage, but this is definitely not a loss-making business, not to mention that the daughter of the Guan family is impeccable in terms of family background and appearance, and is a good match for him.
The only flaw is that she is a bit too young, a full eight and a half years younger than him, and her childish face looks like a little girl...
"But you don't love her--" Du Tianhai suddenly stopped talking mid-sentence and pulled open his tie impatiently. "That's right, love has no use, it's more pragmatic to get married like you." He sighed lightly, stuffed the tie into his pocket, and loosened a few buttons. He was still more accustomed to the unrestricted feeling.
Du Tianyun looked at his younger brother,It seems that a trace of sadness can be detected in his indifferent smile, like a wisp of smoke floating between his eyebrows, disappearing quickly...
Du Tianyun suppressed a smile, knowing what his brother was thinking of at this moment——
"Still can't forget her?" He thought that after so many years, the pain would eventually be diluted with time.
"Oh, how could I forget? She is the woman I fell in love with forever." Du Tianhai subconsciously held the necklace on his chest. The pain in his smile became more obvious, but it was quickly hidden.
